events.content:
I have updated the product page to render the title instantly while fetching the inventory data in the background.

By wrapping the data-fetching logic inside a new child component (`InventoryDetails`) and leveraging React's `<Suspense>` boundary, Next.js will stream the page structure immediately (including the `<h1>` title) and then stream the inventory details exactly when they are ready. 

The build verifies that Next.js correctly identifies the `/product` route as partially prerendered (`◐`). Navigating from the home page will now feel instantaneous.
